en.t: Marcus Aurelius succeeds Antoninus Pius as Roman emperor
en.s: On March 7, 161, Marcus Aurelius succeeded Antoninus Pius as Roman emperor after Pius died at Lorium, in present-day Italy.

zh.t: 马尔库斯·奥勒留继位为罗马皇帝
zh.s: 公元161年3月7日，安敦宁·庇护在位于今天意大利的洛里乌姆去世，马尔库斯·奥勒留继位为罗马皇帝。

en.t: Conrad III is elected King of the Romans at Koblenz
en.s: On March 7, 1138, Conrad III was elected king at Koblenz in the presence of the papal legate Theodwin. His coronation followed at Aachen on March 13.
en.n: The election and coronation took place on different days.

zh.t: 康拉德三世在科布伦茨当选德意志国王
zh.s: 1138年3月7日，康拉德三世在科布伦茨当选国王，教宗使节狄奥温在场。他随后于3月13日在亚琛加冕。
zh.n: 当选与加冕发生在不同日期。

en.s: The Battle of Lisbon of 1373 took place on 7 March 1373. a Castilian fleet led by Ambrosio Boccanegra defeated a Portuguese fleet at the coast of Lisbon. The victory contributed decisively to Castile's victory in the Second Ferdinand War and it resulted in the capture and sack of the city.

zh.s: 1373年3月7日，安布罗焦·博卡内格拉率卡斯蒂利亚舰队，在里斯本海岸击败葡萄牙舰队。这场胜利对卡斯蒂利亚赢得第二次费尔南多战争起了决定性作用，并导致里斯本被攻占和劫掠。

en.t: Ottomans and Venice sign peace in Istanbul
en.s: On March 7, 1573, the Ottoman Empire and the Republic of Venice signed a peace treaty in Istanbul, ending the War of Cyprus. The treaty confirmed Ottoman rule over Cyprus and required Venice to pay 300,000 ducats.
en.n: The location is the treaty signing in Istanbul.

zh.t: 奥斯曼帝国与威尼斯在伊斯坦布尔签订和约
zh.s: 1573年3月7日，奥斯曼帝国与威尼斯共和国在伊斯坦布尔签订和约，结束塞浦路斯战争。条约确认奥斯曼帝国对塞浦路斯的统治，并要求威尼斯支付30万杜卡特。
zh.n: 地点标注的是和约签订地伊斯坦布尔。

en.s: The First War of Villmergen was a Swiss religious war which lasted from 5 January until 7 March 1656, at the time of the Old Swiss Confederacy. On one side were the Protestant cantons of Zürich and Bern, on the other the Catholic cantons of Central Switzerland. The Protestants tried to break the political hegemony of the Catholics, that had been in existence ever since the Second Kappel Landfrieden of 1531.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 维尔梅根第一次战争是旧瑞士邦联时期的一场宗教战争，持续于1656年1月5日至3月7日。一方是苏黎世和伯尔尼的新教州，另一方是中瑞士的天主教州。新教州试图打破天主教州自1531年第二次卡佩尔和平条约以来形成的政治霸权。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Halidzor (Armenian: Հալիձորի ճակատամարտ) took place in the spring of 1727 at Halidzor Fortress, in what is now the Syunik region of Armenia, near the modern-day city of Kapan, between the Armenian forces under the leadership of David Bek and the Ottoman army.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1727年春，亚美尼亚军队在大卫·贝克率领下，与奥斯曼军队在哈利佐尔要塞交战。战场位于今亚美尼亚休尼克州、卡潘市附近。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle off Barbados was fought in March 1778 during the American Revolutionary War. While escorting a fleet of American ships in the West Indies, the frigate USS Randolph was attacked by the British ship-of-the-line HMS Yarmouth. The following action resulted in America's most costly naval defeat, in terms of human lives, until the sinking of USS Arizona in 1941.

zh.s: 巴巴多斯海战发生于1778年3月的美国独立战争期间。护送一支美国船队穿越西印度群岛时，护卫舰“兰道夫号”遭英国战列舰“雅茅斯号”攻击。这场战斗是美国海军伤亡最惨重的一次败仗，直到1941年“亚利桑那号”沉没才被超过。

en.s: The War of the Pyrenees, also known as War of Roussillon or War of the Convention, was the Pyrenean front of the First Coalition's war against the First French Republic. It pitted Revolutionary France against the kingdoms of Spain and Portugal from March 1793 to July 1795 during the French Revolutionary Wars. The war was fought in the eastern and western Pyrenees, at the French port of Toulon, and at sea.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 比利牛斯战争也称鲁西永战争或国民公会战争，是第一次反法同盟对法兰西第一共和国作战时的比利牛斯战线。法国大革命战争期间，革命后的法国与西班牙、葡萄牙两国交战，战争从1793年3月持续至1795年7月。战事发生在比利牛斯山脉东、西两段、法国港口土伦及海上。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的战争开始日期。

en.s: The siege of Jaffa was a military engagement between the French Army under Napoleon Bonaparte and Ottoman forces under Ahmed al-Jazzar. On March 3, 1799, the French laid siege to the city of Jaffa, which was under Ottoman control. It was fought from March 3 to 7, when French forces managed to capture the city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1799年3月3日，法军开始围攻由奥斯曼帝国控制的雅法城。拿破仑·波拿巴率领的法国军队与艾哈迈德·杰扎尔率领的奥斯曼军队交战。围城持续至3月7日，法军最终攻占该城。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of the Monterrey Valley (6 – 7 March 1809) was fought during the Peninsular War outside Monterrei, Orense, in Spain. Resulting in a French victory, it took place in the early stages of Marshal Soult's Second French invasion of Portugal.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1809年3月6日至7日，半岛战争期间，法军在西班牙奥伦塞省蒙特雷附近作战并获胜。这场战役发生在苏尔特元帅第二次入侵葡萄牙的初期。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Craonne was fought on 7 March 1814 and resulted in a French victory under Napoleon I against Russians and Prussians under General Blücher. Craonne is a village on the Chemin des Dames, in the département of Aisne. Marshal Blücher had recovered from his earlier setbacks more quickly than Napoleon Bonaparte had hoped, and so the French Emperor was forced to switch his attacks from the Austrian Field Marshal Schwarzenberg back to the Prussian commander. Moving with speed and aggression, the French pushed the Allies over the Aisne river.

zh.s: 1814年3月7日，拿破仑一世率法军在克拉奥讷击败布吕歇尔指挥的俄普联军。克拉奥讷是法国埃纳省贵妇小径高地上的一座村庄。布吕歇尔从此前挫败中恢复的速度，比拿破仑预料得更快，迫使法皇把进攻目标从奥地利元帅施瓦岑贝格转回普军统帅。法军快速而猛烈地推进，将盟军赶过埃纳河。

en.s: The Battle of Rieti was fought on March 7, 1821 between Austria and Neapolitan rebels. The Austrians were victorious. General Pepe commanded 10,000 men whilst General Frimont of the Austrian army commanded around 14,500 men.

zh.s: 1821年3月7日，奥地利军队与那不勒斯起义军在列蒂交战，奥军获胜。佩佩将军指挥约1万人，奥军弗里蒙将军指挥约14500人。

en.t: Shrigley abduction: 15-year old Ellen Turner is abducted by Edward Gibbon Wakefield, a future figure in the establishment of colonies in South Australia and New Zealand
en.s: The Shrigley abduction was an 1826 British case of a forced marriage by Edward Gibbon Wakefield to the 15-year-old heiress Ellen Turner of Pott Shrigley. The couple were married in Gretna Green, Scotland, and had travelled to Calais, France, by the time authorities were notified by Turner's father and intervened. The marriage was annulled by Parliament, and Turner was legally married two years later, at the age of 17, to a wealthy neighbour of her class.

zh.t: 施里格利绑架案：爱德华·吉本·韦克菲尔德绑架15岁的埃伦·特纳
zh.s: 施里格利绑架案是英国一起发生于1826年的强迫婚姻案件。爱德华·吉本·韦克菲尔德绑架了15岁的富家继承人埃伦·特纳。两人在苏格兰格雷特纳格林结婚，之后到达法国加来；当局接到特纳父亲的通知后介入。议会宣布这段婚姻无效。两年后，17岁的特纳与一名家境相当的富裕邻居结婚。韦克菲尔德后来参与建立了南澳大利亚和新西兰的殖民地。

en.s: The Battle of Carmen de Patagones was a confrontation that occurred on March 7, 1827 between militias of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata and troops from the Imperial Brazilian Navy, during the course of the Cisplatine War. It took place around the town of Carmen de Patagones, in southern Buenos Aires Province, in today's Argentina.

zh.t: 卡门德帕塔戈内斯战役
zh.s: 1827年3月7日，巴西战争期间，拉普拉塔联合省民兵与巴西帝国海军部队，在今阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯省南部卡门德帕塔戈内斯镇周边交战。

en.t: Daniel Webster delivers his Seventh of March speech
en.s: On March 7, 1850, Senator Daniel Webster delivered his “Constitution and the Union” speech in the U.S. Senate, supporting compromise to preserve the Union. He backed Henry Clay’s proposed settlement of the disputes over slavery and the territories.

zh.t: 丹尼尔·韦伯斯特发表“三月七日演说”
zh.s: 1850年3月7日，美国参议员丹尼尔·韦伯斯特在参议院发表《宪法与联邦》演说，主张通过妥协维护联邦统一。他支持亨利·克莱提出的方案，以解决奴隶制和领地问题上的争议。

en.s: The Battle of Wyse Fork, also known as the Battle of Kinston, was fought in the Carolinas campaign of the American Civil War, resulting in a Union Army victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 怀斯福克战役又称金斯顿战役，是美国内战卡罗来纳战役中的一场战斗，最终以联邦军获胜告终。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源资料信息框所列的战斗开始日期。

en.s: On March 7, 1876, the U.S. Patent Office granted Alexander Graham Bell patent 174,465 for his telephone invention. The patent was titled “Improvement in Telegraphy” and had been filed on February 14.
en.n: This date records the patent grant, not the first successful spoken telephone call.

zh.t: 贝尔获得美国第174,465号电话专利
zh.s: 1876年3月7日，美国专利局向亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔授予第174,465号电话发明专利。这项专利名为“电报技术的改进”，申请于2月14日提交。
zh.n: 这里记录专利授权，并非首次成功进行电话通话。

en.s: The 1890 Stamford by-election was held on 7 March 1890, when the incumbent Conservative MP John Lawrance resigned after being appointed a Judge of the Queen's Bench division of the High Court of Justice. The by-election was won by the Conservative Party candidate Henry Cust.

zh.s: 1890年3月7日，英国斯坦福选区举行补选。保守党议员约翰·劳伦斯获任高等法院王座法庭法官后辞职，保守党候选人亨利·卡斯特当选。

en.s: Battle of Poplar Grove. was an incident on 7 March 1900 during the Second Boer War in South Africa. It followed on from the Relief of Kimberley as the British Army moved to take the Boer capital of Bloemfontein. The Boers were demoralised following the surrender of Piet Cronjé at the Battle of Paardeberg. General Sir John French's cavalry attacked the Boer force from the rear while mounted infantry and horse artillery attacked from the right flank. The Boers abandoned their positions in panic before the cavalry. The commander-in-chief of the Free State forces, Christiaan de Wet, in his book called the chapter on the subject "Wild Flight from Poplar Grove".

zh.s: 1900年3月7日，第二次布尔战争期间，英军在解除金伯利之围后，继续向布尔首都布隆方丹推进，在白杨林与布尔军交战。皮特·克龙耶在帕尔德贝格战役投降后，布尔军士气低落。约翰·弗伦奇将军爵士率骑兵从后方进攻，骑马步兵及骑炮兵从右翼攻击，布尔军在骑兵到来前便惊慌弃守。自由邦军总司令克里斯蒂安·德韦特在书中，将记述此事的一章题为《从白杨林仓皇逃离》。

en.s: In the Battle of Tweebosch or De Klipdrift on 7 March 1902, a Boer commando led by Koos de la Rey defeated a British column under the command of Lieutenant General Lord Methuen during the final months of the Second Boer War.

zh.s: 1902年3月7日，库斯·德拉雷率领的布尔突击队在第二次布尔战争末期击败英国纵队，英军指挥官为梅休特中将。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 7 March 1909, with a second round of voting on 14 March. The "ministerial" left-wing bloc remained the largest in Parliament, winning 329 of the 508 seats.

zh.s: 意大利于1909年3月7日举行大选，3月14日进行第二轮。支持政府的左翼集团在508席中赢得329席，继续保持议会最大阵营地位。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Chile on 7 March 1915. The Conservative Party received the most votes in the Chamber of Deputies elections. The Alianza Liberal - Liberals, Radicals and Democrats - won a majority in the Senate while the Coalicion - Conservatives, Liberal Democrats or Balmacedists, and Nationals – won a majority in the Chamber of Deputies.

zh.s: 智利于1915年3月7日举行议会选举，保守党在众议院投票中得票最多。由自由党、激进党及民主党组成的自由联盟赢得参议院多数；保守党、又称巴尔马塞达派的自由民主党及民族党组成的联合阵营，则赢得众议院多数。

en.s: The Ukrainian War of Independence, also referred to as the Ukrainian–Soviet War in Ukraine, lasted from March 1917 to November 1921 and was part of the wider Russian Civil War. It saw the establishment and development of an independent Ukrainian republic, most of which was absorbed into the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic between 1919 and 1920.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乌克兰独立战争在乌克兰也称乌克兰—苏俄战争，发生于1917年3月至1921年11月，是更广泛的俄国内战的一部分。战争期间，乌克兰独立共和国建立并逐步发展；其大部分领土在1919至1920年间并入乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的战争开始日期。

en.t: Konosuke Matsushita establishes Matsushita Electric Housewares Manufacturing Works
en.s: On March 7, 1918, Konosuke Matsushita established Matsushita Electric Housewares Manufacturing Works in Osaka, Japan. The business began with three people: Matsushita, his wife Mumeno, and her brother Toshio Iue. It later became Panasonic.

zh.t: 松下幸之助创办松下电气器具制作所
zh.s: 1918年3月7日，松下幸之助在日本大阪创办松下电气器具制作所。创业时只有三人：松下幸之助、妻子梅野和妻弟井植岁男。这家企业后来发展为松下。

en.s: The Kilfaul ambush was an engagement in the Irish War of Independence. It was the first attack on the British army in Mayo during the War. On Monday 7 March 1921 a Crossley Tender of the 2nd Battalion Border Regiment set out from Ballinrobe towards Castlebar. There were two officers, 15 other ranks and a Royal Army Service Corps driver. They were experienced and well-trained.

zh.s: 基尔福尔伏击战是爱尔兰独立战争中，梅奥郡首次针对英国陆军的攻击。1921年3月7日星期一，边境团第二营一辆克罗斯利运兵车从巴林罗布驶往卡斯尔巴，车上有两名军官、15名其他军人，以及一名皇家陆军勤务团司机。这批人员训练有素且经验丰富。

en.t: The short-lived socialist Labin Republic is proclaimed
en.s: The Labin Republic or Albona Republic (Croatian: Labinska republika, Italian: Repubblica di Albona) was a short-lived self-governing republic that was proclaimed by miners in the Istrian city of Labin (Albona) on March 7, 1921, during a mining strike. It was created in what has been described as the world's first anti-fascist uprising. On April 8, the Italian authorities suppressed the strike by force.

zh.s: 拉宾共和国又称阿尔博纳共和国，是矿工于1921年3月7日在伊斯特拉半岛拉宾市（阿尔博纳）矿业罢工期间宣布成立的短命自治共和国。这次事件被称为世界上第一次反法西斯起义。4月8日，意大利当局以武力镇压罢工。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of East Sydney on 7 March 1931. This was triggered by the death of Labor MP John West. The by-election was won by Labor candidate Eddie Ward, who was associated with New South Wales Premier Jack Lang's wing of the party. This was the last by-election contested by the Nationalist Party as it would be replaced by the United Australia Party later that year.

zh.s: 1931年3月7日，澳大利亚众议院东悉尼选区举行补选，起因是工党议员约翰·韦斯特去世。工党候选人埃迪·沃德赢得补选，他与新南威尔士州州长杰克·朗所在的党内派系关系密切。这是民族党最后一次参加补选；该党于当年晚些时候被澳大利亚联合党取代。

en.t: Finland inaugurates its Parliament House in Helsinki
en.s: On March 7, 1931, Finland inaugurated its Parliament House in Helsinki. The building became the seat of the Finnish Parliament.

zh.t: 芬兰国会大厦在赫尔辛基正式启用
zh.s: 1931年3月7日，芬兰国会大厦在赫尔辛基正式启用，成为芬兰议会的办公场所。

en.s: The Aragon Offensive was an important military campaign during the Spanish Civil War, which began after the Battle of Teruel. The offensive, which ran from March 7, 1938, to April 19, 1938, smashed the Republican forces, overran Aragon, and conquered parts of Catalonia and the Levante.

zh.s: 阿拉贡攻势是西班牙内战期间的一场重要军事行动，发生在特鲁埃尔战役之后。攻势从1938年3月7日持续到4月19日，击溃共和军，攻占阿拉贡，并夺取加泰罗尼亚和莱万特的部分地区。

en.s: The Cartagena uprising (Spanish: Sublevación de Cartagena) was an uprising that occurred in Cartagena during the Spanish Civil War from 4 to 7 March 1939. Soldiers of the Spanish Republican Army sympathetic to Segismundo Casado launched a rebellion against the Republican government of Juan Negrín in Cartagena, the main base of the Spanish Republican Navy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1939年3月4日至7日，西班牙内战期间，卡塔赫纳发生起义。西班牙共和军中支持塞吉斯蒙多·卡萨多的士兵反抗胡安·内格林共和政府。卡塔赫纳是西班牙共和海军的主要基地。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Tjiater Pass occurred between 5 and 7 March 1942 during the Dutch East Indies campaign between invading Japanese forces and the Dutch colonial forces, supported by warplanes from the Royal Air Force. It was fought over control of the Tjiater Pass (now Ciater, part of Subang Regency), as part of an attempted defense of the city of Bandung.

zh.s: 芝亚特山口战役发生于1942年3月5日至7日，是荷属东印度战役的一部分。交战双方为入侵的日军和荷兰殖民军，后者得到英国皇家空军战机支援。双方争夺芝亚特山口（今西爪哇省苏邦县齐亚特一带），这是保卫万隆行动的一部分。

en.s: The Taukkyan Roadblock was an engagement in the Burma campaign in World War II. It was an attempt to clear a roadblock held by elements of the Japanese 33rd Division, which was preventing the evacuation of the main force of the Burma Army from Rangoon. After heavy fighting throughout 7 March 1942, and a counterattack that night, the roadblock was taken on the early morning of 8 March, with little resistance.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

en.s: Operation Ripper, also known as the Fourth Battle of Seoul, was a United Nations (UN) military operation conceived by the US Eighth Army, General Matthew Ridgway, during the Korean War. The operation was intended to destroy as much as possible of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA) and Korean People's Army (KPA) forces around Seoul and the towns of Hongch'on, 50 miles (80 km) east of Seoul, and Chuncheon, 15 miles (24 km) further north.
en.n: Korean War: Operation Ripper: United Nations troops led by General Matthew Ridgway begin an assault against Chinese forces.

zh.s: “撕裂者”行动又称第四次汉城战役，是朝鲜战争期间由美国第八集团军制定的联合国军事行动。行动由马修·李奇微将军指挥，目标是尽可能摧毁汉城及其周边地区的中国人民志愿军和朝鲜人民军，包括汉城以东50英里（80公里）的洪川，以及更北面15英里（24公里）的春川。
zh.n: 朝鲜战争期间，马修·李奇微将军率领联合国军开始向中国军队发起进攻，行动称为“撕裂者”行动。

en.t: Iranian prime minister Ali Razmara is assassinated by Khalil Tahmasebi, a member of the Islamic fundamentalist Fada'iyan-e Islam, outside a mosque in Tehran
en.s: Ali Razmara, also known as Haj Ali Razmara (Persian: علی رزم‌آرا, romanized: ali Razm-ārā; 30 March 1901 – 7 March 1951), was an Iranian military officer and politician who served as the prime minister of Iran from 1950 to 1951. He was assassinated by 26-year-old Khalil Tahmasebi of the Fada'iyan-e Islam organization outside the Shah Mosque in Tehran at the age of 49.

zh.t: 伊朗首相阿里·拉兹马拉在德黑兰遭刺杀
zh.s: 阿里·拉兹马拉又名哈吉·阿里·拉兹马拉（波斯语：علی رزم‌آرا，转写：Ali Razm-ārā；1901年3月30日—1951年3月7日）是伊朗军官和政治人物，1950年至1951年担任伊朗首相。他在德黑兰沙阿清真寺外遭伊斯兰原教旨主义组织法达伊安·伊斯兰成员哈利勒·塔赫马塞比刺杀，时年49岁。

en.t: Northwest Orient Airlines Flight 307 crashes in Lynnhurst, Minneapolis, killing 15 people
en.s: Northwest Orient Airlines Flight 307 was a scheduled international flight with several domestic legs in the United States with the routing Washington, DC–Pittsburgh-Cleveland-Detroit–Madison–Rochester–Minneapolis-St. Paul–Winnipeg. On Tuesday, March 7, 1950, a Martin 2-0-2, registered N93050, was operating the flight when it collided with a flagpole at Fort Snelling National Cemetery on approach to Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport.

zh.t: 西北东方航空307号班机空难，明尼阿波利斯林恩赫斯特地区15人遇难
zh.s: 西北东方航空307号班机是一趟定期国际航班，在美国境内还设有多个国内航段，航线依次途经华盛顿特区、匹兹堡、克利夫兰、底特律、麦迪逊、罗切斯特、明尼阿波利斯—圣保罗和温尼伯。1950年3月7日星期二，一架注册编号N93050的马丁2-0-2客机执飞该航班，在进近明尼阿波利斯—圣保罗国际机场时撞上斯内灵堡国家公墓的一根旗杆。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 7 March 1953 to elect the 75 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The Labor government was seeking its eighth continuous term in office since the 1932 election. It was the first electoral test for Vince Gair, who had become Premier of Queensland 14 months earlier after the death of Ned Hanlon.

zh.s: 1953年3月7日，澳大利亚昆士兰州举行选举，选出州议会75名议员。工党政府力争自1932年选举以来连续第八次执政。这是文斯·盖尔成为州长14个月后首次接受选举考验；他是在内德·汉隆去世后接任州长的。

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 7 March 1953. All 39 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Liberal and Country League led by Premier of South Australia Thomas Playford IV defeated the Australian Labor Party led by Leader of the Opposition Mick O'Halloran.

zh.s: 1953年3月7日，南澳大利亚州举行州选举，州众议院全部39席改选。由州长托马斯·普莱福德四世领导的现任自由与乡村联盟击败由反对党领袖米克·奥哈洛伦领导的澳大利亚工党。

en.s: A leadership ballot in the Australian Labor Party, the opposition party in the Parliament of Australia, was held on 7 March 1960. It followed the retirement of previous leader H. V. Evatt. Calwell received 42 votes to Reg Pollard's 30 in a caucus ballot. Future Prime Minister Gough Whitlam would defeat Eddie Ward to become Calwell's deputy.

zh.s: 前党魁H.V.伊瓦特退休后，澳大利亚国会反对党工党于1960年3月7日选举领导人。卡尔韦尔在议员团投票中以42票对30票击败雷格·波拉德。未来总理高夫·惠特拉姆则击败埃迪·沃德，成为副党魁。

en.s: The 1963 Urban Council Election was held on 7 March 1963 for the 4 of the 8 elected seats of the Urban Council of Hong Kong.

zh.s: 1963年3月7日，香港市政局举行选举，改选8个民选议席中的4席。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 7 March 1965. Voters were presented with a single list from the People's Democratic Front (FDP), which was dominated by the Romanian Workers Party (PMR). The Front won 465 seats in the Great National Assembly.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于1965年3月7日举行议会选举。选民只能对罗马尼亚工人党主导的人民民主阵线单一名单投票，该阵线取得大国民议会465席。

en.s: On 7 March 1965, an Aeroflot Lisunov Li-2 operating as Aeroflot Flight 542 (Abakan to Kyzyl) crashed shortly after takeoff from Abakan. Approximately 40 minutes after departure, the aircraft banked left and dived into the mountains of the Krasnoyarsk Krai region of the USSR. All 31 passengers and crew died, making it the deadliest known accident involving the Li-2.

zh.s: 1965年3月7日，一架执飞苏联民航542号班机的李-2客机从阿巴坎飞往克孜勒，起飞后不久坠毁。飞机离开机场约40分钟后向左倾斜，坠入苏联克拉斯诺亚尔斯克边疆区的山区。机上31名乘客和机组人员全部遇难，这是已知最严重的李-2客机事故。

en.s: The Singaporean by-election of 1967 was triggered by the final batch of mass resignations from Barisan Sosialis (BS)'s elected Members of Parliament who heeded to Lim Huan Boon's call on the grounds that Singapore's independence was "phony" because no discussion of Singapore's separation matter was made in the legislature. The final walkout of BS members were Koo Young, Ms Loh Miaw Gong, Ong Lian Teng, Poh Ber Liak and Tan Cheng Tong and translates into five vacant constituencies namely, Bukit Panjang, Havelock, Jalan Kayu, Tampines and Thomson. As a result, the by election was held on 7 March 1967 with the nomination day set on 24 February 1967.

zh.s: 1967年新加坡补选，源于社会主义阵线最后一批民选议员集体辞职。他们响应林焕文的号召，认为新加坡脱离马来西亚一事未经立法机关讨论，因此独立是“假的”。最后辞职的五名议员包括Koo Young、Loh Miaw Gong、Ong Lian Teng、Poh Ber Liak和Tan Cheng Tong，留下武吉班让、合乐、惹兰加由、淡滨尼及汤申五个选区空缺。补选于1967年3月7日举行，提名日为2月24日。

en.s: The 1967 Orlando mayoral special election was held on March 7, 1967, following a primary election on February 21, 1967, to elect the mayor of Orlando, Florida. Mayor Bob Carr, who was re-elected to his third term in 1964 died on January 29, 1967. Following Carr's death, City Commissioner George Barker served as Mayor Pro Tem until the vacancy was filled at a special election, and Barker declined to contest the election.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州奥兰多于1967年3月7日举行市长特别选举，此前2月21日进行初选。鲍勃·卡尔市长于1964年获选第三个任期，却在1967年1月29日去世。市委员乔治·巴克暂代市长，直到补选填补空缺，他本人拒绝参选。

en.s: The 1969 Israeli Labor Party leadership election was held on 7 March 1969. Held in the aftermath of the death in office of party leader and prime minister Levi Eshkol, it saw the party's Central Committee elect Golda Meir as the party's new leader.

zh.s: 1969年3月7日，以色列工党举行党魁选举。党魁兼总理列维·埃什科尔在任内去世后，工党中央委员会选举果尔达·梅厄为新任党魁。

en.s: The 1970 Football League Cup final took place on 7 March 1970 at Wembley Stadium with an attendance of 97,963. It was the tenth Football League Cup final and the fourth to be played at Wembley. It was contested between Manchester City and West Bromwich Albion, with City winning their first of the two trophies that season; on 29 April they would win the 1970 European Cup Winners' Cup final against Górnik Zabrze 2–1.

zh.s: 1970年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于1970年3月7日在温布利球场举行，现场观众97,963人。这是第10届联赛杯决赛，也是第4次在温布利举行。曼城对阵西布罗姆维奇，最终曼城获胜，赢得该赛季两项奖杯中的第一项；4月29日，他们又在欧洲优胜者杯决赛中以2比1击败扎布热戈尔尼克。

en.t: 7 March Speech of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
en.s: The 7th March Speech of Mujib, or the 7/3 Speech (Bengali: সাতই মার্চের ভাষণ, romanized: Sāta'i Mārcēra Bhāṣaṇa), was a public speech given by Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, the founding leader of Bangladesh on 7 March 1971 at the Ramna Race Course (now Suhrawardy Udyan) in Dhaka to a gathering of over one million (1,000,000) people.

zh.t: 谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼“3月7日演讲”
zh.s: 谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼的“3月7日演讲”又称“7/3演讲”，是孟加拉国奠基者于1971年3月7日在达卡拉姆纳赛马场（今苏拉瓦迪·乌迪扬）发表的公开演讲，现场有超过100万人。

en.s: The 1972 New Hampshire Republican presidential primary was held on March 7, 1972, in New Hampshire as one of the Republican Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1972 United States presidential election. Incumbent President Richard Nixon faced his first major test in New Hampshire against two minor challengers: liberal anti-Vietnam war candidate Pete McCloskey of California and conservative John Ashbrook of Ohio, who opposed Nixon's détente policies towards China and the Soviet Union.

zh.t: 1972年新罕布什尔州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1972年3月7日举行共和党总统初选，作为该党当届总统候选人提名程序的一部分。现任总统理查德·尼克松在此迎来首次主要考验，对手是两名影响较小的挑战者：加州自由派反越战候选人皮特·麦克洛斯基，以及俄亥俄州保守派约翰·阿什布鲁克，后者反对尼克松对中国及苏联的缓和政策。

en.s: The 1972 New Hampshire Democratic presidential primary was held on March 7, 1972, in New Hampshire as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1972 United States presidential election.

zh.t: 1972年新罕布什尔州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1972年3月7日举行民主党总统初选，作为该党在1972年美国总统选举前进行的州级提名竞逐之一。

en.s: Elections to the Assam Legislative Assembly were held in March 1972 to elect members of 114 constituencies in Assam, India. The Indian National Congress won the popular vote and a majority of seats and Sarat Chandra Singha was re-appointed as the Chief Minister of Assam. The number of constituencies was set as 126 by the recommendation of the Delimitation Commission of India.

zh.s: 1972年3月，印度阿萨姆邦举行立法议会选举，选出114个选区的议员。印度国民大会党赢得最多普选票和过半席位，萨拉特·钱德拉·辛哈再次出任邦首席部长。根据印度划界委员会的建议，选区总数定为126个。

en.s: Pakistan General elections of 1977 were held in Pakistan on 7 March 1977 to elect the 200 parliamentarians (for both houses (Senate and National Assembly) for the Parliament of Pakistan. The general elections were the second elections held in the history of the country as well as the first after the split of the country.

en.s: General elections were held in Guatemala on 7 March 1982. Ángel Aníbal Guevara, hand-picked successor of previous president Romeo Lucas García, was declared the winner of the presidential election and was scheduled to take office on 1 July. However, the election was widely denounced as fraudulent by elements on both sides of the political spectrum and an army-led coup d'état on 23 March instead installed the three-man junta of General Efraín Ríos Montt, General Horacio Maldonado Schaad, and Colonel Francisco Luis Gordillo Martínez. Voter turnout was 45.83% in the presidential election.

zh.s: 危地马拉于1982年3月7日举行大选。前总统罗梅奥·卢卡斯·加西亚钦定的接班人安赫尔·阿尼瓦尔·格瓦拉，被宣布赢得总统选举，原定7月1日就职。但左右各派普遍谴责选举舞弊。3月23日军方发动政变，改由埃弗拉因·里奥斯·蒙特将军、奥拉西奥·马尔多纳多·沙德将军及弗朗西斯科·路易斯·戈迪略·马丁内斯上校，组成三人军政府。总统选举投票率为45.83%。

en.s: A general election was held in the Northern Territory, Australia on Saturday 7 March 1987. Although the incumbent Country Liberal Party (CLP) won a majority under new leader Stephen Hatton, the party's vote was down almost 20 percentage points. At the 1987 election, the CLP faced a challenge from the Northern Territory Nationals, a rebel conservative party led by former CLP Chief Minister Ian Tuxworth that was aligned with then-Queensland Premier Joh Bjelke-Petersen, but not affiliated with the federal National Party of Australia. The NT Nationals took 17.79% of the primary vote, mostly from the CLP, but finished with only one member in the assembly.

zh.s: 澳大利亚北领地于1987年3月7日星期六举行大选。执政的乡村自由党在新领袖斯蒂芬·哈顿领导下赢得多数，但得票率下降近20个百分点。该党面对前首席部长伊恩·塔克斯沃思领导的保守派分裂组织北领地国家党挑战。后者与昆士兰州长约翰·比耶尔克-彼得森合作，但不隶属联邦国家党，取得17.79%的首选票，主要来自乡村自由党，却最终仅获一个议席。

en.s: The 1987 Lieyu massacre occurred on 7 March 1987 at Donggang Bay, Lieyu Island ("Lesser Kinmen" or "Little Quemoy"), Kinmen, Fuchien, Republic of China (ROC) when soldiers from the ROC Army's 158 Heavy Infantry Division killed 24 Vietnamese refugees on the shoreline of Donggang Bay, including eight children (one baby), five women (one pregnant) and eleven men.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Federated States of Micronesia on 7 March 1989 alongside a referendum on electing a Constitutional Convention. All candidates for seats in Congress ran as independents. The referendum was held in compliance with article 2, section 9 of the constitution, which specified that there must be a referendum on convening a Constitutional Convention at least every ten years. It was approved by 71% of voters, and the Constitutional Convention election was subsequently held in 1990.

zh.s: 密克罗尼西亚联邦于1989年3月7日举行议会选举，并公投决定是否选举制宪会议。所有国会议席候选人均以独立人士身份参选。宪法规定至少每十年就召开制宪会议举行一次公投，原文将依据条款列为第2条第9款。71%的选民支持提案，制宪会议选举随后于1990年举行。

en.t: Iran breaks diplomatic relations with the United Kingdom
en.s: On March 7, 1989, the Iranian government announced that it was breaking diplomatic relations with the United Kingdom. The move followed the dispute over Salman Rushdie’s novel The Satanic Verses and Ayatollah Khomeini’s death threat against the author.

zh.t: 伊朗宣布与英国断绝外交关系
zh.s: 1989年3月7日，伊朗政府宣布与英国断绝外交关系。此前，双方因萨尔曼·鲁西迪的小说《撒旦诗篇》，以及霍梅尼对作者发出的死亡威胁而发生争执。

en.s: The Ribble Valley by-election, in Lancashire, England, took place on 7 March 1991 following the elevation of United Kingdom MP David Waddington to the House of Lords. Michael Carr of the Liberal Democrats won election at his third attempt. The seat, based largely on the market town of Clitheroe, had previously been safely Conservative but at the time the controversial Margaret Thatcher's "Poll Tax" policy was used by opposition parties against the Conservative candidate. The tax was abolished soon afterwards by Thatcher's successor John Major, who had succeeded Thatcher on her resignation in November 1990.

zh.s: 英国议员戴维·沃丁顿晋入上议院后，英格兰兰开夏郡里布尔谷选区于1991年3月7日举行补选。自由民主党的迈克尔·卡尔在第三次尝试中当选。这个以克利瑟罗集镇为中心的选区，原本是保守党稳固席位，但反对党利用撒切尔有争议的“人头税”政策攻击保守党候选人。撒切尔于1990年11月辞职，由约翰·梅杰接任；补选后不久，梅杰便废除这项税。

en.s: A special election was held for Rizal's 1st district seat to the House of Representatives of the Philippines on March 7, 1994. Gilberto Duavit Sr. won the special election to serve the final 14 months of former representative Manuel Sanchez's term. This was the first competitive special election held under the auspices of the 1987 constitution; the special elections in 1993 were all uncontested.

zh.t: 1994年黎刹省第一国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 1994年3月7日，菲律宾黎刹省第一国会选区举行众议员特别选举。老吉尔贝托·杜阿维特当选，接任前议员曼努埃尔·桑切斯剩余14个月任期。这是1987年宪法实施后首场有竞争的特别选举，1993年的特别选举均无人竞争。

en.s: On March 7, 1995 a mayoral election was held in Burlington, Vermont, United States. Progressive Coalition nominee Peter Clavelle, the former mayor who had lost reelection in the 1993 election, defeated incumbent Republican Mayor Peter Brownell, Democratic nominee Paul Lafayette, and other candidates. Brownell ended the Progressive's control over the mayoralty with his victory in the 1993 election, but during his tenure the Progressives gained control over the city council.

zh.t: 1995年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 美国佛蒙特州伯灵顿于1995年3月7日举行市长选举。曾在1993年连任失败的前市长彼得·克拉韦尔，作为进步联盟候选人，击败共和党现任市长彼得·布朗内尔、民主党候选人保罗·拉法耶特及其他候选人。布朗内尔1993年的胜利曾结束进步派对市长职位的控制，但其任内进步派取得了市议会多数。

en.s: The 1995 Tampa mayoral election took place on March 7, 1995. Incumbent Mayor Sandra Freedman was term-limited and unable to run for re-election to a third full consecutive term. Former Mayor Dick A. Greco, who had previously served from 1967 to 1974, and County Commissioner Jan Platt ran to succeed her. Greco defeated Platt by a wide margin, receiving 66 percent of the vote to her 32 percent.

zh.s: 美国坦帕于1995年3月7日举行市长选举。现任市长桑德拉·弗里德曼受任期限制，无法争取连续第三个完整任期。1967年至1974年任市长的迪克·A.格雷科，与县委员扬·普拉特角逐继任。格雷科以66%对32%的得票率，大幅领先获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Vavunathivu took place during the Sri Lankan Civil War. It occurred on 7 March 1997 in which the LTTE militants attacked and overran the Sri Lanka Army military camp at Vavunathivu off Batticaloa.

zh.s: 1997年3月7日，斯里兰卡内战期间，泰米尔猛虎组织袭击并攻占拜蒂克洛阿附近瓦武纳蒂武的斯里兰卡陆军营地。

en.s: The Attack on Prekaz, also known as the Prekaz massacre, was an operation led by the Special Anti-Terrorism Unit of Serbia which lasted from 5 to 7 March 1998, whose goal was to eliminate Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) suspects and their families. During the operation, KLA leader Adem Jashari and his brother Hamëz were killed, along with nearly 60 other family members.

zh.s: 1998年3月5日至7日，塞尔维亚反恐特别部队展开普雷卡兹袭击行动，又称普雷卡兹屠杀，目标是清除科索沃解放军嫌疑人员及其家属。行动中，科索沃解放军领导人阿德姆·亚沙里和他的兄弟哈梅兹，以及近60名其他家人遇害。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia on 7 March 1999. The elections proved disastrous for the Estonian Coalition Party, which won only seven seats together with two of its smaller allies. The Estonian Country People's Union, which participated the election on its own list, obtained seven seats as well. The programme of Mart Laar’s government was signed by Pro Patria Union, Reform Party, Moderates and People’s Party. The latter two merged soon after, so Mart Laar’s second government is widely known as Kolmikliit, or Tripartite coalition.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚于1999年3月7日举行议会选举。联合党惨败，与两个小盟党合计仅获7席。单独以名单参选的乡村人民联盟也获得7席。祖国联盟、改革党、温和派及人民党签署马尔特·拉尔政府的施政纲领。后两党不久合并，因此拉尔第二届政府通常被称为“三党联盟”。

en.s: The Rey de Reyes 1999 (Spanish for "King of Kings") was the third annual Rey de Reyes professional wrestling tournament and show, produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA). The event took place on March 7, 1999 in the Toreo de Cuatro Caminos arena in Naucalpan, Mexico State, Mexico. The Rey de Reyes tournament consisted of a semi-final round of four four-man elimination matches and a final match with the winners of each of the semi-finals facing off in an elimination match until one man remained. The final of the 1999 Rey de Reyes tournament pitted Cibernético, Octagón, Latin Lover and Electroshock against each other.

zh.s: “王中之王1999”是墨西哥AAA摔角联盟举办的第三届年度“王中之王”职业摔角锦标赛及赛事，于1999年3月7日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的四路斗牛竞技场举行。锦标赛先进行四场四人淘汰赛，四名胜者再进入决赛，以淘汰方式角逐，直到只剩最后一人。1999年决赛由Cibernético、Octagón、Latin Lover及Electroshock对阵。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 7 March 1999. The result was a victory for Francisco Flores of the Nationalist Republican Alliance, who won in the first round with 52.0% of the vote.

en.s: The 1998 Chinese Football Super Cup (Chinese: 1998年度中国足球超霸杯赛) was the 4th Chinese Football Super Cup, contested by Chinese Jia-A League 1998 winners Dalian Wanda Shide and 1998 Chinese FA Cup winners Shanghai Shenhua. Shanghai Shenhua beat Dalian Wanda Shide 3–0 and won their second Chinese Football Super Cup title.

zh.s: 1998年中国足球超霸杯是第4届中国足球超霸杯，由1998年中国足球甲A联赛冠军大连万达实德队对阵1998年中国足协杯冠军上海申花队。上海申花以3比0战胜大连万达实德，第二次夺得中国足球超霸杯冠军。

en.s: The 2000 Missouri Republican presidential primary on March 7, 2000, determined the recipient of the state's 35 delegates to the Republican National Convention in the process to elect the 43rd president of the United States. It was an open primary. The primary marked the end of Missouri's use of the caucus system, which it had used almost exclusively until 2000.

zh.t: 2000年密苏里州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 密苏里州于2000年3月7日举行开放式共和党总统初选，决定该州参加全国代表大会的35名代表支持谁，作为选出美国第43任总统的提名程序之一。密苏里此前几乎一直采用党团会议，这次初选标志着其改换制度。

zh.t: 2000年密苏里州民主党总统初选

en.s: The 2000 California Republican presidential primary was held on March 7, 2000. Governor George W. Bush of Texas won easily over Senator John McCain of Arizona and former Ambassador Alan Keyes. At the time, California had a blanket primary, meaning all candidates of all parties were on the same ballot, but the state parties, exploiting a loophole in the election law, used color-coded ballots so that only votes from party members would count.

zh.t: 2000年加利福尼亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2000年3月7日举行共和党总统初选。得克萨斯州州长乔治·W.布什，轻松击败亚利桑那州参议员约翰·麦凯恩及前大使艾伦·凯斯。当时加州采用混合初选，各党所有候选人列在同一张选票上，但州政党利用选举法漏洞，以不同颜色标识选票，只计算本党成员的票。

zh.t: 2000年马里兰州民主党总统初选

en.s: The 2000 Georgia Democratic presidential primary was held on March 7, 2000, as one of 16 contests scheduled on Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The Georgia primary was an open primary, which awarded 93 delegates to the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of whom 77 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the primary results.

zh.t: 2000年佐治亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年3月7日，佐治亚州举行民主党总统初选，是民主党“超级星期二”安排的16场初选之一。该州采用开放式初选，共分配93名代表参加2000年民主党全国代表大会，其中77名为承诺代表，按初选结果分配。

en.s: The 2000 Massachusetts Democratic presidential primary took place on March 7, as one of 16 contests scheduled on Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Washington primary the weekend before. The Massachusetts primary was a semi-closed primary, with the state awarding 118 delegates towards the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 93 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年马萨诸塞州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年3月7日，马萨诸塞州举行民主党总统初选，是“超级星期二”安排的16场初选之一，前一周末刚举行华盛顿州初选。该州采用半开放式初选，共分配118名代表参加2000年民主党全国代表大会，其中93名为承诺代表，按初选结果分配。

en.s: The inaugural government-funded Adelaide International Film Festival (AIFF) took place in Adelaide, Australia, from 28 February to 7 March 2003, with screenings, special events and forums presented in various cinemas and locations. Established by South Australian Premier Hon. Mike Rann to stimulate the local film industry and celebrate the 30th anniversary of the South Australian Film Corporation, the festival showcases and explores contemporary screen culture with a program of screenings, special events and forum sessions.

zh.s: 首届由政府资助的阿德莱德国际电影节于2003年2月28日至3月7日在澳大利亚阿德莱德举行，在多家影院和不同场地举办电影放映、特别活动和论坛。电影节由南澳大利亚州州长迈克·兰创办，旨在推动当地电影业发展，并纪念南澳大利亚电影公司的成立30周年。活动展示并探讨当代银幕文化。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 7 March 2004. The New Democracy Party of Kostas Karamanlis won the elections, ending eleven years of rule by the Panhellenic Socialist Movement (PASOK). PASOK was led into the elections by George Papandreou, who succeeded retiring Prime Minister Costas Simitis as party leader in February.

zh.s: 希腊于2004年3月7日举行议会选举。科斯塔斯·卡拉曼利斯的新民主党获胜，结束泛希腊社会主义运动11年的执政。社会主义运动由乔治·帕潘德里欧领军参选，他于2月接替即将退休的首相科斯塔斯·西米蒂斯，出任党魁。

en.s: The 2004 Equatorial Guinea coup attempt, also known as the Wonga Coup, failed to replace President Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo with exiled opposition politician Severo Moto Nsá. Mercenaries organised by mainly British financiers were arrested in Zimbabwe on 7 March 2004 before they could carry out the plot. Prosecutors alleged that Moto was to be installed as the new president in return for preferential oil rights to corporations affiliated with those involved in the coup.

zh.s: 2004年赤道几内亚未遂政变，又称“旺加政变”，企图以流亡反对派政治家塞韦罗·莫托·恩萨，取代总统特奥多罗·奥比昂·恩圭马·姆巴索戈，但没有成功。主要由英国出资者组织的雇佣兵，在执行计划前于2004年3月7日在津巴布韦被捕。检方指称，莫托将获扶上总统职位，以换取给予政变参与者关联公司优先石油权益。

en.s: The 2004 Carinthian state election was held on 7 March 2004 to elect the members of the Landtag of Carinthia, Austria. The election was a victory for the first-term Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) government under Jörg Haider, which repeated its strong performance from the previous election. This came despite difficulties on the federal level and recent defeats in other state elections, as well as a strong challenge from the Social Democratic Party of Austria (SPÖ).

zh.s: 2004年3月7日，奥地利克恩顿州举行选举，选出州议会议员。由约尔格·海德尔领导的奥地利自由党政府赢得胜利，延续了上届选举的强劲表现。尽管该党在联邦层面面临困难，并在近期其他州选举中失利，仍成功抵挡了奥地利社会民主党的有力挑战。

en.s: The 2004 Salzburg state election was held on 7 March 2004 to elect the members of the Landtag of Salzburg. The result was a historic victory for the Social Democratic Party of Austria (SPÖ), which became the largest party in the state for the first time in history. The SPÖ achieved a decisive swing of over thirteen percentage points, winning 45.4% of votes cast.

zh.s: 2004年3月7日，萨尔茨堡州举行州选举，选出州议会议员。奥地利社会民主党取得历史性胜利，首次成为该州最大党。该党得票率上升超过13个百分点，达到45.4%。

en.s: The 2006 Varanasi bombings were a series of bombings that occurred across the Hindu holy city of Varanasi in India on Tuesday, 7 March 2006. At least 28 people are reported to have been killed and as many as 101 others were injured.

zh.s: 2006年3月7日星期二，印度教圣城瓦拉纳西多地接连发生爆炸。据报道，至少28人死亡、多达101人受伤。

en.s: On March 7, 2006, a mayoral election was held in Burlington, Vermont, United States. Incumbent Mayor Peter Clavelle declined to seek reelection and Progressive nominee Bob Kiss was elected to succeed him.

zh.t: 2006年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 美国佛蒙特州伯灵顿于2006年3月7日举行市长选举。现任市长彼得·克拉韦尔不再争取连任，进步党候选人鲍勃·基斯当选接任。

en.s: Garuda Indonesia Flight 200 (GA200/GIA200) was a scheduled domestic passenger flight of a Boeing 737-400 operated by Garuda Indonesia between Jakarta and Yogyakarta, Indonesia. The aircraft overran the runway, crashed into a rice field and burst into flames while landing at Adisucipto International Airport on 7 March 2007. Twenty passengers and one flight attendant were killed. Both pilots survived, and were fired shortly after the accident occurred.

zh.s: 印尼鹰航200号班机（GA200/GIA200）是一架波音737-400客机，执飞雅加达到日惹的印尼国内定期航班。2007年3月7日，飞机在日惹阿迪苏吉普托国际机场降落时冲出跑道，坠入稻田并起火。20名乘客和一名空乘人员遇难。两名飞行员均生还，事故发生后不久被解雇。

en.s: The 2007 Northern Ireland Assembly election was held on Wednesday, 7 March 2007. It was the third election to take place since the devolved assembly was established in 1998. The election saw endorsement of the St Andrews Agreement and the two largest parties, the Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) and Sinn Féin, along with the Alliance Party, increase their support, with falls in support for the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the Social Democratic and Labour Party (SDLP).

zh.s: 2007年3月7日星期三，北爱尔兰举行议会选举。这是1998年设立权力下放议会以来的第三次选举。选举结果支持《圣安德鲁斯协议》。民主统一党、新芬党和联盟党支持率上升，阿尔斯特统一党和社会民主工党支持率下降。

en.t: Commons backs a fully elected House of Lords in an indicative vote
en.s: On March 7, 2007, the UK House of Commons voted 337 to 224 in favour of a motion stating that a reformed House of Lords should be fully elected. The vote expressed the House’s opinion and did not itself enact the reform.
en.n: This was an opinion motion, not a law changing the chamber’s membership.

zh.t: 英国下议院表决支持上议院全部由选举产生
zh.s: 2007年3月7日，英国下议院以337票赞成、224票反对，通过意见动议，支持改革后的上议院全部由选举产生。这次表决表达了下议院的立场，并未直接实施改革。
zh.n: 表决对象是意见动议，并非改变上议院成员产生方式的法律。

en.s: The 2008 Saudi Crown Prince Cup final was the 33rd final of the Crown Prince Cup. It took place on 7 March 2008 at the King Fahd International Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and was contested between Al-Hilal and Al-Ettifaq. It was Al-Ettifaq's fourth Crown Prince Cup final and Al-Hilal's eighth. This was the first meeting between these two clubs in the final.

zh.s: 2008年沙特王储杯决赛是该项赛事的第33届决赛，于3月7日在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的法赫德国王国际体育场举行，由利雅得新月对阵达曼协作。这是达曼协作第4次、利雅得新月第8次晋级王储杯决赛，也是两队首次在决赛中相遇。

en.s: The 2008 Andean diplomatic crisis was a diplomatic stand-off involving the South American countries of Ecuador, Colombia and Venezuela. It began with an incursion into Ecuadorian territory across the Putumayo River by the Colombian military on March 1, 2008, leading to the deaths of over twenty militants, including Raúl Reyes (nom-de-guerre of Luis Edgar Devia Silva) and sixteen other members of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2008年安第斯外交危机是厄瓜多尔、哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉之间的外交对峙。危机始于2008年3月1日哥伦比亚军队越过普图马约河侵入厄瓜多尔境内，造成20多名武装人员死亡，其中包括化名劳尔·雷耶斯的路易斯·埃德加·德维亚·席尔瓦，以及哥伦比亚革命武装力量的另外16名成员。

zh.s: 中国南方航空6901号班机发生一起未遂袭击，导致飞机改道飞往兰州。事件未造成人员受伤。

en.s: On 7 March 2009, two off-duty British soldiers of the 38 Engineer Regiment were shot dead outside Massereene Barracks in Antrim, Northern Ireland. Two other soldiers and two civilian delivery men were also wounded. A dissident Irish republican paramilitary group, the Real IRA, claimed responsibility. The shootings were the first British military fatalities in Northern Ireland since 1997.

zh.s: 2009年3月7日，两名英国陆军第38工兵团的休班士兵在北爱尔兰安特里姆的马瑟里恩军营外遭枪击身亡，另有两名士兵和两名平民送货员受伤。爱尔兰共和派的分裂武装组织‘真正爱尔兰共和军’宣称对此负责。这是1997年以来英国军人在北爱尔兰首次遭袭身亡。

en.t: 2009 Ontario New Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 2009 Ontario New Democratic Party leadership election was held in Hamilton, from March 6 to 8, 2009 to elect a successor to Howard Hampton as leader of the Ontario New Democratic Party (NDP). On June 15, 2008, Hampton informed the party's provincial council that he would not stand for re-election as leader at the next party convention in a year's time.

zh.t: 2009年安大略新民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 2009年3月6日至8日，安大略新民主党在汉密尔顿举行党魁选举，选出接替霍华德·汉普顿的新任党魁。2008年6月15日，汉普顿告知该党省级委员会，他不会在一年后的下次党代会上竞选连任。

en.s: The 2010 Superfinalen was the second edition of Superfinalen, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Tippeligaen and Norwegian Cup competitions. Modeled on the FA Community Shield, the match is intended to be a season opener, with the net proceeds going to charity. It took take place on 7 March 2010, at Color Line Stadion, Ålesund, and was contested by Rosenborg and Aalesund, winners of the 2009 Tippeligaen and 2009 Norwegian Football Cup respectively.

zh.s: 2010年挪威超级决赛是该项年度足球赛事的第2届，由上赛季挪威足球超级联赛和挪威杯冠军对阵，赛制仿照英格兰社区盾杯，旨在开启新赛季，净收益捐作慈善用途。比赛于2010年3月7日在奥勒松的科洛尔线球场举行，由2009年挪超冠军罗森博格对阵挪威杯冠军奥勒松。

en.s: A legislative election was held in Belize on 7 March 2012 to elect all 31 members of the Belize House of Representatives as well as offices in the various local governments. The election was run by the Elections and Boundaries Commission's Elections and Boundaries Department. Dean Barrow and his United Democratic Party (UDP) were re-elected, but lost eight seats to the opposition People's United Party (PUP) to maintain a slim 17-14 majority in the Belize House. The upper house of the Belize National Assembly, the Senate, was appointed after the election by the UDP-led government in accordance with the Constitution of Belize.

zh.s: 伯利兹于2012年3月7日举行议会及地方选举，改选众议院全部31席及各地方政府职位，由选举与边界委员会下属部门组织。迪安·巴罗领导的联合民主党连任，但向反对党人民联合党丢掉8席，在众议院仅以17比14保有微弱多数。国会上院参议院成员，则由联合民主党领导的政府依宪法在选后任命。

en.s: A by-election for the UK House of Commons constituency of Mid Ulster in Northern Ireland was held on 7 March 2013. The election was triggered by the resignation of Martin McGuinness, who had been elected to the seat in 1997 as the Sinn Féin candidate. The election was won by Francie Molloy, also of Sinn Féin.

zh.s: 北爱尔兰中阿尔斯特选区于2013年3月7日举行英国下议院补选。马丁·麦吉尼斯辞职，导致议席空缺，他在1997年以新芬党候选人身份当选。同属新芬党的弗朗西·莫洛伊赢得补选。

en.s: The 2014 Uzbekistan Super Cup was the second UzPFL-Supercup. It was contested by the winners and runners up of the 2013 Uzbek League. Bunyodkor had also the won 2013 Uzbekistan Cup. The match was contested by Bunyodkor and Lokomotiv Tashkent, at JAR Stadium in Tashkent, on 7 March 2014. Bunyodkor Tashkent won the match 2:1.

zh.s: 2014年乌兹别克斯坦超级杯是第2届乌兹别克斯坦职业足球联赛超级杯，由2013年乌兹别克联赛冠军和亚军参赛。由于本尤德科同时赢得2013年乌兹别克杯，本场由本尤德科对阵塔什干火车头。比赛于2014年3月7日在塔什干的JAR体育场举行，本尤德科以2比1获胜。

en.s: Elections were held on March 7, 2017, in Los Angeles, California. Voters elected candidates in a nonpartisan primary, with runoff elections scheduled for May 16, 2017. Eight of the fifteen seats in the City Council were up for election, as well as the offices of mayor, city attorney and city controller. Four ballot measures were also on the ballot.

zh.s: 美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶于2017年3月7日举行市级选举初选，第二轮定于5月16日。选民以无党派形式选出市议会15席中的8席，以及市长、市检察官和市审计长。选票还包括四项公投提案。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Federated States of Micronesia on 7 March 2017, alongside a referendum on allowing dual citizenship. Although the proposed constitutional amendment to allow dual citizenship was approved by a majority of voters, it did not pass the threshold of 75% voting in favour in at least three of the four states.

zh.s: 密克罗尼西亚联邦于2017年3月7日举行议会选举，并就允许双重国籍举行公投。虽然多数选民支持修宪提案，但未达到四州中至少三州有75%选民赞成的通过门槛。

en.s: The 2017 Los Angeles mayoral election was held on March 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Los Angeles. Due to a change in the city's election calendar to align mayoral elections with statewide elections, the winner stood to serve a term of five years and six months instead of the usual four years. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 2017年3月7日，洛杉矶举行市长选举。由于该市调整选举日程，使市长选举与州级选举同步，当选者的任期将为五年半，而非通常的四年。加利福尼亚州市政选举在法律上不设党派。

en.s: The Battle of Mugi was fought between the Indonesian Army (TNI-AD) and the West Papua National Liberation Army (TPNPB) on 7 March 2019 in Mugi District, Nduga Regency, Papua province, Indonesia. The attack, which killed three Indonesian military personnel and 7-10 TPNPB militants, is the single deadliest military engagement in Indonesia in 2019, and was the deadliest single military engagement in Operation Nemangkawi until surpassed by the 2021 Maybrat attack.

zh.s: 2019年3月7日，印度尼西亚陆军与西巴布亚民族解放军在印度尼西亚巴布亚省恩杜加县穆吉区交战。袭击造成3名印尼军人和7至10名西巴布亚武装人员死亡，是印尼2019年伤亡最惨重的一次军事交战，也是“内曼卡维行动”中伤亡最惨重的一次交战，直到2021年马布拉特袭击发生后才被超过。

en.s: UFC 248: Adesanya vs. Romero was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on March 7, 2020, at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.s: ‘UFC 248：阿德萨尼亚对罗梅罗’是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2020年3月7日在美国内华达州帕拉代斯的T-Mobile竞技场举行。帕拉代斯位于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2020 Ontario Liberal Party leadership election concluded on March 7, 2020, resulting in the election of Steven Del Duca, a former cabinet minister in the government of Kathleen Wynne, as Ontario Liberal Party’s 33rd leader. The leadership election took place following the resignation of Kathleen Wynne after over five years at the helm of the party.

zh.s: 2020年安大略自由党党魁选举于2020年3月7日结束，前省政府内阁部长史蒂文·德尔·杜卡当选该党第33任党魁。此次选举是在凯瑟琳·韦恩辞去党魁职务后举行的，她已领导该党五年多。

en.s: The 2020 Kuomintang chairmanship by-election (Chinese: 2020年中國國民黨主席補選) was held on 7 March 2020. This was the ninth direct election of the party leader in Kuomintang history. All registered, due-paying KMT party members were eligible to vote.

zh.s: 2020年中国国民党主席补选于2020年3月7日举行，是国民党历史上第九次直接选举党主席。所有已登记并缴纳党费的党员均有投票资格。

en.s: The 2021 La Paz gubernatorial election was held on Sunday, 7 March 2021, with a runoff taking place on 11 April 2021, involving separate contests for governor and all forty-five seats in the Departmental Legislative Assembly. Incumbent governor Félix Patzi unsuccessfully sought reelection to a second term, finishing in fourth place with 4.36 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 玻利维亚拉巴斯省于2021年3月7日星期日举行省长及省议会全部45席选举，第二轮于4月11日举行。现任省长费利克斯·帕齐争取第二个任期失败，仅以4.36%的选票位列第四。

en.s: The 2021 El Alto municipal election was held on Sunday, 7 March 2021, to elect the mayor and eleven councillors to the El Alto Municipal Council. Incumbent Mayor Soledad Chapetón was eligible to seek a second term but declined for personal reasons. Fourteen fronts (seven civic groups and seven political parties) presented candidates.

zh.s: 玻利维亚埃尔阿尔托于2021年3月7日星期日举行地方选举，选出市长及11名市议员。现任市长索莱达·查佩通虽有资格争取第二个任期，但因个人原因不再参选。共有14个阵营推出候选人，包括七个公民团体及七个政党。

en.s: The 2021 Beni gubernatorial election was held on Sunday, 7 March 2021, to elect the governor of Beni, Bolivia. Alex Ferrier, the incumbent governor after the 2015 gubernatorial election but who resigned during the 2019 political crisis, ran to return to office for a second term.

zh.s: 玻利维亚贝尼省于2021年3月7日星期日举行省长选举。亚历克斯·费列尔在2015年选举后担任省长，但在2019年政治危机中辞职，这次参选希望重返职位，争取第二个任期。

en.s: The 2021 Bolivian regional elections were held on 7 March 2021. Departmental and municipal authorities were elected by an electorate of approximately 7 million people. This was the third regional election under the 2009 constitution. It was postponed from the expected date of 2020 due to the 2019 Bolivian political crisis and delays in holding the 2020 Bolivian general election. All elected authorities assumed office on 3 May.

zh.s: 玻利维亚于2021年3月7日举行省级及市级选举，约700万选民选出地方官员。这是2009年宪法下的第三次地方选举。受2019年政治危机及2020年全国大选延迟影响，地方选举也从原定2020年推迟。所有当选官员于5月3日就职。

en.s: The 2021 La Paz municipal election was held in La Paz, Bolivia on Sunday, 7 March 2021, involving separate contests for mayor and all eleven municipal council seats. Incumbent mayor Luis Revilla was eligible to seek a third term but declined, leaving the mayoralty an open contest. The election was won by former minister of public works Iván Arias of the Somos Pueblo alliance, who attained a near absolute majority of 49.52 percent against a field of ten other candidates.

zh.s: 2021年拉巴斯市政选举于3月7日星期日在玻利维亚拉巴斯举行，分别选举市长和全部11名市议员。时任市长路易斯·雷维利亚有资格竞选第三个任期，但决定不再参选，因此市长选举没有现任者参加。前公共工程部长、‘我们是人民’联盟候选人伊万·阿里亚斯击败另外10名候选人，以49.52%的得票率胜出，距过半仅一步之遥。

en.s: The 2021 FC Barcelona presidential election took place on 7 March 2021 for electing the 41st President of the club.

zh.t: 2021年巴塞罗那足球俱乐部主席选举
zh.s: 2021年巴塞罗那足球俱乐部主席选举于2021年3月7日举行，选出俱乐部第41任主席。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Federated States of Micronesia on 7 March 2023 to elect the fourteen members of the Congress: ten representatives of the districts, and four senators each representing one of the four states.

zh.t: 2023年密克罗尼西亚联邦议会选举
zh.s: 密克罗尼西亚联邦于2023年3月7日举行议会选举，选出国会全部14名议员：10名由各选区选出的代表，以及4名分别代表全国四个州的参议员。

en.s: The 2023 Tampa mayoral election was held on March 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Tampa, Florida. The election was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent mayor Jane Castor ran for re-election to a second term in office. Castor was the only candidate on the ballot, as the only other person who qualified for the race was a write-in candidate. Castor easily won a second term, receiving more than 80% of the vote.

zh.s: 2023年3月7日，佛罗里达州坦帕举行市长选举，选举不设党派。现任市长简·卡斯特竞选连任，争取第二个任期。选票上只有她一名正式候选人，另一名合格候选人以书写方式参选。卡斯特轻松连任，得票率超过80%。

en.s: The 2023 NXT Roadblock was the fourth Roadblock professional wrestling event produced by WWE. It was primarily for wrestlers from the NXT brand division. Like the previous Roadblock event, NXT Roadblock aired as a special episode of NXT on the USA Network. The television special took place on March 7, 2023, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida.

zh.s: 2023年NXT Roadblock是WWE举办的第4届Roadblock职业摔角赛事，主要由NXT品牌选手参加。与上一届一样，本届赛事作为NXT特别节目在USA电视网播出。节目于2023年3月7日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的WWE表演中心举行。

en.s: The 2023 St. Louis aldermanic elections were held in two rounds, with nonpartisan blanket approval voting primaries on March 7 and general elections on April 4. All 14 members of the St. Louis Board of Aldermen and the President of the Board of Aldermen were elected. These were the first elections held after Proposition R (2012) came into effect, reducing the number of alderpersons from 28 to 14.

zh.s: 2023年圣路易斯市议员选举分两轮进行：3月7日举行不分党派、全员可投的初选，4月4日举行普选。市议会全部14个席位和议长职位均进行选举。这是2012年R提案生效后首次举行此类选举，该提案将市议员人数从28人减至14人。

en.s: The Progress Chapter 165: Diamond Dust was a professional wrestling event produced by Progress Wrestling. It took place on 7 March 2024, in London, England at The Dome. Eight matches were contested at the event. The main event saw Kid Lykos defeat Lio Rush to retain the PROGRESS World Championship.

zh.s: ‘PROGRESS第165章：钻石尘’是PROGRESS摔角举办的职业摔角赛事，于2024年3月7日在英格兰伦敦的The Dome场馆举行。赛事共安排8场比赛。压轴赛中，Kid Lykos击败Lio Rush，卫冕PROGRESS世界冠军。

en.s: PFL Europe 1 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Professional Fighters League that took place on March 7, 2024, at the Accor Arena in Paris, France.

zh.s: ‘PFL欧洲第1场赛事’是职业格斗联盟举办的综合格斗赛事，于2024年3月7日在法国巴黎的雅高竞技场举行。

en.s: The Kachin Independence Army's (KIA) offensive in Kachin State, known unofficially as Operation 0307 (after the date it began), is an ongoing military operation against the Tatmadaw military junta of Myanmar which began on 7 March 2024. Primarily centred along the road connecting Myitkyina to Bhamo, Operation 0307 was launched to capture junta bases which could threaten Laiza, the headquarters of the KIA.

zh.s: 克钦独立军在克钦邦发动的攻势非正式名称为“0307行动”，以开始日期命名。这是针对缅甸军政府的一场持续军事行动，于2024年3月7日开始。行动主要沿密支那至八莫的公路展开，目标是夺取可能威胁克钦独立军总部莱扎的军政府基地。

en.t: 2025 Democratic Unionist Party deputy leadership election
en.s: The 2025 Democratic Unionist Party deputy leadership election was held on 7 March 2025 to fill the Deputy Leader position within the Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) which had been vacant since May 2024. Strangford MLA Michelle McIlveen was elected unopposed.

zh.s: 2025年3月7日，民主统一党举行副党魁选举，填补自2024年5月起一直空缺的职位。斯特兰福德选区议员米歇尔·麦克伊尔文在无人竞争的情况下当选。

en.t: Dynamite Fighting Show 26 takes place in Râmnicu Vâlcea
en.s: On March 7, 2025, Dynamite Fighting Show 26: Vengeance Day, a kickboxing and boxing event, took place at the Traian Arena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania.

zh.t: Dynamite Fighting Show 26在勒姆尼库沃尔恰举行
zh.s: 2025年3月7日，Dynamite Fighting Show 26“复仇日”踢拳与拳击赛事在罗马尼亚勒姆尼库沃尔恰的特拉扬体育馆举行。
